Another Cautionary Tale for MamdaniMarts

Consumers tend to like their produce from real markets.

By

As more than a century of experiments in socialism have demonstrated, supermarkets without market discipline tend to disappoint consumers. This week brings yet another cautionary tale as New York City prepares to launch city-owned grocery stores starting next year.
